# DPPTool

DPPTool provides practical, browser-based tools and guidance for the EU Digital Product Passport (DPP), ESPR and related product-data workflows.

## Core resources
- https://dpptool.com/digital-product-passport/ — main DPP guide
- https://dpptool.com/dpp-checker/ — product scope checker
- https://dpptool.com/dpp-readiness/ — readiness assessment
- https://dpptool.com/dpp-deadlines/ — current DPP timeline
- https://dpptool.com/dpp-standards/ — DPP standards and interoperability
- https://dpptool.com/dpp-platform/ — platform architecture
- https://dpptool.com/tools/ — free browser tools

## Important notes
- DPPTool is informational and is not a law firm, notified body or EU institution.
- Product-specific DPP obligations depend on applicable EU legislation and delegated acts.
- Priority status in an ESPR working plan is not the same as a binding application deadline.
